name: Technology Entrepreneurship Minor
intro: The Technology Entrepreneurship minor prepares students to design, prototype, and launch technology-driven products and ventures. Unlike traditional entrepreneurship programs that emphasize management or commercialization, this minor focuses on the hands-on technical skills, tools, and development processes used by modern startups.
